questions.originalHtml:
Imagine that you are hiking in the mountains one afternoon with friends. As you turn a corner, you come across a mother bear and her cubs standing in the middle of the trail.

  1. Identify the specific division of the nervous system that is responsible for the body’s response to this situation.
  2. Describe at least six physiological responses you might have upon seeing the bears.
  3. Indicate the division of the nervous system that is responsible for returning the body back to equilibrium after the event is over.

Textbook p. 399
